verdict.summary_en: Karton Nowak order confirmation OA26377328 for Soony PO 4500318722 (dated 2026-08-28). Confirms 75,000 Cover Sleeves (CMP-GAM-004) at 0.06 EUR for 2026-09-18 and 12,500 Art Books (CMP-GAM-008) at 2.1 EUR for 2026-10-07. DAP Hamburg, NET30. A note says the sleeve is printed to artwork rev. C, received from Soony Marketing on 2026-08-07. The document is printed and has no handwriting or stamps.
red_flags: The sleeve note says printing follows artwork rev. C, received 2026-08-07. The document does not say whether rev. C is the current approved revision, so the buyer should check that against its own records.
The document has no confirmation date or issue date of its own.
The ordered quantities are not shown separately. The Qty column is read as the confirmed quantity.
observations: Clean, printed digital document with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
Qty column header is just 'Qty'; it is recorded as quantity_confirmed.
Decimal point format is English style in unit prices (0.06, 2.1); thousands separators are commas (75,000).
